purpose: Independent, preregistered verification of the freshly published N0 rev-3 convergence report at one instant-bound hash. Recompute the certified orders from the raw rung errors (no builder import, no solver rerun), re-measure every pin, and test the stop-rule closures. This is a measurement, not a gate verdict, and not a new numerical run.
scope_limits: no solver execution; no solver code imported by the verifier
read-only on every canonical path; writes only under artifacts/worker-071/n0_rev3_verify/
does not re-adjudicate N0 physics, the protocol reviews, or the lock state
verdict binds only the pins below; any later write to a pinned path voids it at the pin
checks: P1 all preregistered pins resolve on disk at the preregistered hashes
P2 every (path, sha256) pair embedded in the rev-3 report resolves on disk
P3 four rungs per scheme in the certification artifact; dr set {0.2,0.1,0.05,0.025}; dt constant 1e-4; steps equal within scheme
P4 recomputed least-squares order from cert rung errors equals declared fit_order
P5 recomputed order from the report's own l2_error_by_dr map equals the cert-derived order
P6 recomputed pair orders match declared pair_orders; delta_R5 equals max(pair half-range, least-squares SE)
P7 cross-scheme max |order difference| matches declared; every order within p_design +/- p_tol; monotone error decay
P8 constant-CFL ladders are marked supporting-only; the certified ladders are the fixed-dt ladders; cnfd constant-CFL is inadmissible-as-spatial per the temporal control
P9 stop-rule closures: 4-rung closure backed by 4 rows; F0 rebind resolves to the canonical F0 rev5 hash; at least one independent-replication verdict with resolvable evidence
P10 lock guard: numerics/spherical_solver absent; report lock_state=locked; production_allowed=false
P11 report internal_checks.all_pass true, failures empty, >= 50 checks
P12 report declares conclusion_type=numerical_evidence, gate=G-NUM, class_id=AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH, and a non-empty claims_not_made list
controls: K1 synthetic p=2 ladder -> estimator returns 2.0 within order_identity
K2 synthetic p=1 ladder -> estimator returns 1.0 within order_identity (sensitivity)
K3 perturb one rung error in-memory -> declared-vs-recomputed detector fires above detector_min_delta
K4 determinism: two full recomputations agree exactly
K5 end-of-run re-hash of all pins; any change raises DRIFT and fails closed

verdict_rule.VERIFIED_AT_PIN: P1-P12 pass and K1-K4 fire as specified and K5 shows no drift

falsifier: Re-run verify_rev3.py at the pinned hashes: any P check FAIL, any control not firing, or any pinned-hash change falsifies or voids this verification.
stop_rule: 0.5 agent-hours or one verification record; report REFUTED/DRIFT rather than patching past a failed check.
non_claims: not a gate verdict; gate authority is Astra and the group leads
not a numerical replication of the solver (no solver execution)
not a mathematical statement about self-gravitating dynamics
no status=done and no validation_status=passed is claimed
